mechanism_narrative: A higher current unemployment rate signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is positive or not statistically significant (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals active monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC is not negative (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment above 4.5% and industrial production below 105 signals dual stress in labor and manufacturing sectors, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting both conditions, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, housing starts below 1700 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST < 1700 cases, or Rank IC is not negative (p >= 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC is not negative (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 5.0% combined with CPI above 3.0% signals dual monetary policy challenges that increase real rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: In periods meeting both conditions, SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 360,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS > 360000 periods, or Rank IC is not positive (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of UNRATE < 4.0% periods, or Rank IC is not positive (p >= 0.05) over any 3-year window.
